title: Pip Counts One Two Three Seeds
genre: a story about sharing, kindness or trying again
first_line: Little Pip has one round seed in his beak.
summary: Pip the little blue bird shares his seeds one by one with his woodland friends, learning that sharing brings happy smiles to everyone.

title: Bramble's Big Blue Balloon
genre: a story about sharing, kindness or trying again
first_line: Little Bramble the blue bunny found a shiny red balloon floating near the garden gate.
summary: Bramble the blue bunny finds a red balloon and learns the joy of sharing it with Pip the yellow duckling. Together, they watch it dance in the breeze as a new day begins.

title: Barnaby Turtle Slows Down to See
genre: a rhyming mini-story about an animal friend who learns a small lesson
structure: a repeating refrain the child can say along
first_line: Meet Barnaby Turtle in the soft green grass.
summary: Barnaby Turtle learns that rushing makes him stumble, but slowing down helps him notice tiny, wonderful friends in the grass. He enjoys a peaceful, happy day by taking his time.

title: Luna Fox Counts the Evening Stars
genre: a gentle bedtime mini-story that ends calmly
first_line: The sun goes down behind the hill.
summary: Luna the fox counts up to five glowing night elements while taking deep breaths to calm down for sleep.

title: Oliver Owl Finds the Quiet Moon
genre: a rhyming mini-story about an animal friend who learns a small lesson
first_line: Little Oliver Owl was wide awake.
summary: Little Oliver Owl tries to stay awake to catch fireflies, but after a gentle reminder from his mother, he learns to relax and fall asleep.

title: Milo Fox Shares a Shiny Red Berry
genre: a story about sharing, kindness or trying again
first_line: Once upon a quiet hill, a little fox named Milo found a sweet red berry.
summary: Milo Fox finds a tasty red berry and happily shares half of it with his hungry friend Pip the mouse.
